generic_root_cause: Carrier census spreadsheets frequently format employee and dependent headers with possessive tokens (e.g. Employee's Legal Name (First), Dependent's Legal Name (Last)) and repeat the subscriber employee's name across dependent rows. Normalization of possessive tokens and carrier legal name aliases preserves 100% direct tabular ingestion, filters template instruction rows, and links dependents to existing subscribers without spawning duplicate employee records.
applicable_conditions: Census spreadsheet headers carry legal name variants with possessive tokens (Employee's Legal Name (First), Dependent's Legal Name (Last))
Subscriber employee name is repeated across dependent rows in tabular census
Template instruction/example rows present (row number or first column labeled Ex or Example)
Part-time employees who waive medical coverage are excluded from active census deliverables

conditions: tabular census carries possessive legal name headers or repeated subscriber name on dependent rows

root_cause.summary: Normalize possessive tokens in column headers, match carrier legal name aliases for first/last/dep names, skip example rows (Ex), and link repeated subscriber names on dependent rows to existing employees.

preconditions: carrier census spreadsheet carries legal name columns or repeated subscriber on dependent rows
exclusions: do not link dependent if relationship indicates an independent subscriber

generic_root_cause: When census employee first name matches invoice subscriber with corroborating plan/tier but surname differs, comparison assigns Review - Name Mismatch. This mismatch must be propagated to findings counters, exceptions, and summary notes so the Findings Summary and exception reports faithfully reflect the census worksheet warning.
applicable_conditions: Comparison result is Review - Name Mismatch
First name matches with matching plan/tier and coverage
Surname differs between census employee and invoice subscriber

conditions: employee comparison yields Review - Name Mismatch but summary counter or findings notes omit the discrepancy

root_cause.summary: Propagate Review - Name Mismatch to findings counters, exceptions list, and summary findings notes to guarantee 100% agreement between Census worksheet flags and the Summary Sheet.

preconditions: comparison row receives Review - Name Mismatch
exclusions: do not count clean 100% or alias 95% matches as name mismatches

Invoice records or text contain subscriber with matching last name and first initial
Corroborating tier, plan, ZIP, age, or medical premium aligns

generic_root_cause: Under Section 2.3, 9.2, and 21.1, employees who have waived coverage or have explicit waiver reasons must be strictly coded as WO with plan NA and cobra N, must NEVER have active tiers derived from dependents, and must NEVER have Most Used Plan applied or be flagged as Not On Invoice. Linked dependents of waived employees, and dependents with their own waiver evidence, must be excluded from active medical census (EXCLUDE_NON_MEDICAL_ONLY).
applicable_conditions: Employee or dependent has explicit waiver reason or waived status on census
Coverage tier unassigned or defaulting to active tiers (EF/FAM/EE/ES/EC) from linked dependents
Waived employee incorrectly flagged as Not On Invoice with Most Used Plan applied

conditions: waived employee or dependent assigned active coverage tier or included in active medical census

root_cause.summary: Enforce authoritative WO coverage for waived employees, exclude waived dependents as non-medical, and ensure waived employees are Expected - Not Enrolled without Most Used Plan.

preconditions: employee or dependent has waiver evidence

promotion.reason: Validated against Section 2.3, 9.2, and 21.1 invariants

generic_root_cause: Under Section 22.1 & 22.2, when a source census document specifies a Total Rate or combination of Employee Contribution and Employer Contribution that matches the billed invoice premium, the census premium must be recognized at full total rate rather than employer contribution only, and false-positive Premium Discrepancy flags must not be recorded.
applicable_conditions: Source census specifies Total Rate column or Employee Contribution + Employer Contribution
Census total rate matches invoice premium but false Premium Discrepancy was reported
Premium alias mapping omitted Total Rate or Employee Contribution

conditions: false premium discrepancy where census total rate matches invoice premium

root_cause.summary: Recognize Total Rate as primary census premium and reconcile with invoice premium to eliminate false discrepancy exceptions.

preconditions: census row contains rate matching invoice premium

promotion.reason: Validated against Section 22 premium reconciliation invariants

generic_root_cause: Census rows can carry blank or invalid coverage values (e.g. '-1') or non-standard waiver shorthand (e.g. 'QW' qualified waiver). Payroll registers / labor distributions can list paid employees absent from the census, and the GHQ/RFP declared full-time headcount can differ from the census count. These were detected in validation but never surfaced to the agent. A shared clarification engine (backend/clarifications.py) now detects all four conditions from data, the email lists them under 'Census Clarification', and RULE_25_AGENT_CLARIFICATIONS fails the run if any detected item is omitted.
applicable_conditions: Census employee coverage value blank or not mappable to an approved code
Census coverage shorthand ending in a bare W (QW/SW/OW) standardized heuristically to WO
Payroll/labor distribution person (LAST,FIRST (ID:n)) not matching any census person or invoice subscriber
Prospect ft_employees (GHQ/RFP grid or text) != reportable census employee count

conditions: detected census clarification not present in Missing Information Email

root_cause.summary: Detected clarifications must flow to the email via clarifications.collect_clarifications.

preconditions: census present

promotion.reason: Validated by regression suite tests/test_agent_clarifications.py

generic_root_cause: Excel census workbooks may contain formatting artifacts, cell styles, or formulas extending across thousands of empty columns (up to column 16,384/XFD), causing severe performance degradation, runaway delimiter expansion, and memory saturation if boundaries are not strictly truncated at structured table extent.
applicable_conditions: Worksheet max_column exceeds structured tabular header columns
Consecutive empty column gap of >= 5 columns across all rows
Presence of phantom or styled blank cells beyond valid data range (e.g. columns A:M vs A:XFD)

conditions: max_column exceeds tabular range by >= 5 empty columns

root_cause.summary: Truncate worksheet ingestion at the first column where >= 5 consecutive columns are completely empty across all data rows.

preconditions: contiguous structured table headers identified in columns A:N
exclusions: do not truncate valid multi-tier tables with single empty spacer columns

promotion.reason: Validated against Feedback.docx Wellfit Technologies worksheet extent audit (Columns A:M bounded)

generic_root_cause: Tabular census rosters frequently present family members as stacked rows directly beneath the primary employee where Job Title indicates relationship ('Spouse', 'Child', 'Domestic Partner') rather than employment, with blank employment fields (hire date, salary, employment status). Failing to recognize these rows as dependents causes severe employee headcount inflation.
applicable_conditions: Row contains a relationship indicator ('Spouse', 'Child', 'Domestic Partner', 'Dependent') in Job Title or Notes
Employment fields such as hire date, annual pay, or employee status are blank or identical to dependent profile
Preceding row represents an active employee subscriber

conditions: job title matches relationship keyword and preceding employee exists

root_cause.summary: Reconstruct stacked census rows as dependents (SP, CH, DP) attached to preceding subscriber employee; prevent registering them as standalone employees.

preconditions: preceding subscriber employee established in current file parsing context
exclusions: do not reclassify legitimate employees whose job title contains 'partner' in a professional capacity (e.g., 'VP, Strategic Partnerships')

promotion.reason: Validated against Feedback.docx Wellfit Technologies 104-employee active census invariant (122 stacked dependents attached)

generic_root_cause: PEO and Insperity enrollment rosters encode medical benefit options as comma-delimited strings (e.g. 3,57,58,12) alongside single-character coverage tier codes (E, S, C, K, F, W, I). Treating these as literal or invalid single codes causes false plan rejections and erroneous 'Waived without plan' anomalies.
applicable_conditions: Census or enrollment document originates from Insperity or PEO platform
Coverage level uses single-letter codes (E, S, C, K, F, W, I)
Option code contains comma-separated numeric/alphanumeric benefit identifiers

conditions: coverage level is single-letter or option contains comma-delimited string

root_cause.summary: Split comma-delimited option codes, map medical plan codes using Group Identification Key legend (e.g. Code 3 -> Choice Plus 500), map non-medical only codes (57,58) to WO, and normalize single-letter coverage tiers (E->EE, S->ES, C/K->EC, F->EF, W->WO, I->NE).

preconditions: valid option string or single letter coverage code
exclusions: do not override explicit standard two-letter tiers (EE, ES, EC, FAM, WAIVE)

promotion.reason: Validated against Feedback.docx Insperity Group Identification Key decoding rules

generic_root_cause: When carrier invoices are absent, Benefits Enrollment Reports (BER) serve as the primary invoice-equivalent billing document. BER files frequently aggregate multi-benefit lines (Dental, Vision, Life, Commuter, FSA) across hundreds of rows and lack a total premium column. Rejecting BERs for lack of premium columns generates false 'No invoice was provided' errors and inflates counts.
applicable_conditions: No standard monthly carrier billing statement provided in submission
Benefits Enrollment Report (BER) or Benefit Elections workbook is present
BER contains medical tier, coverage level, or employee pre-tax deduction amounts across multi-line products

conditions: BER not recognized as invoice or non-medical rows leak into subscriber invoice census

root_cause.summary: Classify BER as invoice-equivalent when no carrier invoice is present, accept subscriber election and tier columns without requiring total gross premium, and strictly filter out non-medical benefit lines.

preconditions: workbook classified as BER or benefit elections
exclusions: do not parse non-medical rows as medical invoice subscribers

promotion.reason: Validated against Feedback.docx Benefits Enrollment 2 acceptance as invoice equivalent

generic_root_cause: When renewal rate tables are extracted from PEO reports (e.g. MAR Report, Financial Stewardship Report), rate structures and plan tiers must be applied to comparison rate fields without overwriting or displacing the canonical active census population (104 employees). Erroneously deriving or modifying the active employee roster from renewal exhibits creates headcount discrepancies.
applicable_conditions: PEO renewal rate tables extracted from MAR, Stewardship, or renewal exhibits
Canonical active employee census established from primary census documents
Renewal comparison requires future rate population

conditions: renewal rate application alters canonical census employee records or count

root_cause.summary: Populate renewal rate tables strictly into renewal rate fields; enforce invariant canonical employee count across all downstream workbook writer stages.

preconditions: canonical census population finalized
exclusions: never add, remove, or replace active census employees based on renewal exhibits

promotion.reason: Validated against Feedback.docx MAR and Stewardship report rate population without employee displacement

Primary gender column is blank, whitespace, NaN, XXXX, N/A, or Unknown while secondary Sex/Gender column is populated
Wide row contains both employee sex and dependent sex columns

conditions: same-person usable gender/sex candidate exists
blank or masked placeholder in primary column

applicable_conditions: Wide dependent columns in census contain masked placeholders (XXXX)
Secondary enrollment or benefit report lists dependent rows linked by subscriber ID or employee name
Multiple children share subscriber ID and surname

conditions: masked dependent slots in census
real dependent records in enrollment source

generic_root_cause: Multi-line benefit enrollment files mix Medical lines with Dental, Vision, Life, STD/LTD, Accident, Critical Illness, and HSA/FSA lines, causing dental/vision/life-only dependents or part-time excluded dependents to leak into active medical population if not filtered by per-person medical coverage disposition.
applicable_conditions: Enrollment table includes Plan Type / Plan Category / Provider columns with non-medical lines
Employee elects Medical EE alongside Dental/Vision/Life family tiers (EF/ES/EC)
Census includes Waived (WO), Waiting Period (WP), Not Eligible (NE), or Part-Time rows

conditions: candidate dependent has only non-medical coverage associations or part-time subscriber

root_cause.summary: Assign explicit Section 4 dispositions (INCLUDE_ACTIVE_MEDICAL, RETAIN_MEDICAL_STATUS, EXCLUDE_NON_MEDICAL_ONLY, EXCLUDE_PART_TIME, UNRESOLVED) and exclude non-medical-only dependents.

preconditions: evaluate all coverage associations across sources before finalizing dependent disposition
exclusions: never apply Most Used Plan to WP, NE, WO, or RC

Dual workbook generation (Marsh + SBU) for Cigna non-Florida routing

conditions: post-sort or post-filter row order finalized

generic_root_cause: Comparison columns in generated census workbooks inherit currency number format ($#,##0.00) from preceding census premium column, causing Match % to render as $1.00 or decimal instead of 100% with Section 18 color coding (100% green, 80-99% orange, <80% red).
applicable_conditions: Workbook contains comparison area starting after primary census columns
Match % column populated from comparison results
Template comparison cells uninitialized or inheriting currency formatting from census premium

conditions: match percentage rendered with currency format or without Section 18 colors

root_cause.summary: Reset all comparison columns to General formatting, explicitly assign number_format='0%' to Match %, and apply Section 18 green/orange/red font colors.

preconditions: comparison match percentage populated
exclusions: do not alter premium currency formatting in columns R and S

promotion.reason: Validated against Section 6 execution gates and Section 7 regression suite

generic_root_cause: Employee legal first name in census differs from invoice subscriber name (e.g. Derek vs Kyle), but preferred first name, middle name, or alternate alias matches the invoice subscriber with matching surname and corroborating plan/tier or title.
applicable_conditions: Census contains preferred first name, middle name, or alternate alias
Invoice subscriber first name matches census employee preferred or middle name
Employee surname matches invoice subscriber surname
Plan, tier, or job title corroborates identity

conditions: employee unmatched on invoice despite preferred name or middle name match

root_cause.summary: Reconcile census employee with invoice subscriber via preferred first name, middle name, or known alias, assigning 95% match score and preserving exact invoice subscriber name.

preconditions: preferred name or middle name matches invoice subscriber first name with matching surname
exclusions: do not match if surname differs and no corroborating evidence exists

promotion.reason: Validated against Section 6 execution gates and Section 7 regression suite

generic_root_cause: Template example/sample rows (e.g. marked with 'Ex', 'Example', 'Sample' in leading index cells, or carrier template dummy names like John Smith, Cindy Parker) were inadvertently ingested when column A was blank/NaN and row checks inspected only series.iloc[0].
applicable_conditions: Spreadsheet contains header example or sample rows marked with 'Ex' or 'Example'
Leading column A is blank or NaN while column B holds 'Ex' or row numbering
Template dummy records must be excluded from canonical population totals

conditions: census rows contain 'Ex' or template example demographics

preconditions: row contains example marker 'Ex' or matches template sample structure
exclusions: do not exclude real numbered rows 1, 2, 3...

generic_root_cause: High-deductible health plans with HSA compatibility (e.g. '1700 HSA', 'CPOSII HSA', 'OAAS HSA') were erroneously discarded as non-medical spending accounts due to containing the string 'hsa', dropping valid medical subscribers from invoice and comparison.

Plan carries medical network or design acronyms (ppo, pos, cpos, oaas, afa, sgp, hdhp, cdhp)
Subscribers on HSA medical plans must be retained as active medical enrollment

conditions: medical plan containing HSA classified as non-medical

root_cause.summary: Protect HSA-compatible health plans with medical keywords from non-medical exclusion and isolate standalone spending accounts.

preconditions: plan carries medical network/benefit signals
exclusions: do not preserve standalone HSA deposit/fee accounts

promotion.reason: Validated against Section 6 execution gates and Section 7 regression suite

generic_root_cause: Multi-division TPA billing statements (e.g. Meritain Health group 14642) format subscribers as 'LAST FIRST' without commas and organize lines by DIVISION blocks. Strict comma requirements in fragment filters dropped valid subscribers, collapsing invoice counts and causing blank Match %.
applicable_conditions: Invoice is a structured Meritain Health or TPA billing statement
Document organizes subscribers under division headers with fixed-cost premiums
Subscriber names are formatted without commas

conditions: invoice subscriber count collapsed relative to text volume

root_cause.summary: Deterministic statement parsing extracts division-specific subscribers and maps plans and fixed-cost monthly premiums without comma requirements.

preconditions: invoice contains division headers and subscriber rows
exclusions: do not parse non-medical billing lines

promotion.reason: Validated against Section 6 execution gates and Section 7 regression suite

generic_root_cause: Under Section 9.1, employees identified as Part-Time (PT) must be excluded from the medical census regardless of whether medical coverage is indicated in the source file, preventing population inflation.
applicable_conditions: Census contains Part-Time (PT) employees in employment status or worker category
Part-time records must be excluded from employee totals, enrollment totals, and deliverable census

conditions: part-time employee present in output census

Invoice contains multiple entries or text for that name with distinct subscriber/member IDs

conditions: distinct DOBs for same name
missing invoice flag on one individual

generic_root_cause: An employee appears across multiple census source files with identical or nickname names and matching home addresses/ZIPs, but minor variations in DOB (e.g. 1-year discrepancy) or status (active vs waiver), causing redundant duplicate rows in the census.

Matching name and address with <= 1 year DOB difference
One record is actively enrolled or on invoice while the other is marked waiver/non-enrolled

conditions: cross-source duplicate records with identical address and near-identical DOB

generic_root_cause: Under Section 21.2 & 30.6, when a primary census states an employee is Waiver / Not Enrolled (WO/NE) or Refused Coverage (RC), but an active carrier invoice lists active medical coverage (or with DOB variation), the census waiver election must be preserved, the comparison result flagged as Eligibility Conflict in red, and any DOB discrepancy annotated in comparison notes and findings exceptions.
applicable_conditions: Employee marked as Waiver / Not Enrolled (WO/NE) or RC on census
Active medical coverage found for subscriber on carrier invoice
DOB variation exists between census and invoice/carrier records

conditions: non-enrolled employee with active medical invoice or unannotated DOB conflict

root_cause.summary: Preserve authoritative census waiver election (WO/NE) during cross-source deduplication, assign Eligibility Conflict with red highlight, and annotate DOB conflicts dynamically in notes and exception reports.

preconditions: census non-enrolled employee with active medical invoice

promotion.reason: Validated against Section 6 execution gates and Section 7 regression suite
